d: Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

Are you a dedicated Civil Engineer ready to make a meaningful impact on Kuwait's infrastructure development We're looking for a talented and innovative Civil Engineer to join our dynamic team in Kuwait. In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced professionals to design, plan, and execute civil engineering projects that shape our built environment. If you're passionate about solving complex engineering challenges, committed to excellence, and eager to grow your career in a supportive and inclusive workplace, we'd love to hear from you!
Design and develop civil engineering solutions for infrastructure projects, including structural analysis, feasibility studies, and technical specifications
Conduct site surveys, inspections, and assessments to evaluate project conditions and ensure compliance with local building codes and regulations in Kuwait
Prepare detailed technical drawings, reports, and documentation using CAD software and other industry-standard tools
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including architects, contractors, and project managers to ensure seamless project execution and delivery
Analyze project data and conduct engineering calculations to support design decisions and optimize project outcomes
Supervise construction activities and monitor quality assurance to ensure all work meets relevant industry standards and specifications
Stay current with industry advancements, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation in our engineering solutions
Identify and resolve engineering challenges through creative problem-solving and analytical thinking
Communicate effectively with stakeholders, clients, and team members to maintain transparency and foster collaborative relationships
q: We are seeking talented Civil Engineers who possess
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Proficiency in CAD software and engineering design tools
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively in team environments and embrace diversity and inclusion
Knowledge of civil engineering principles, construction methodologies, and project management
Familiarity with local building codes, regulations, and standards applicable in Kuwait
Demonstrated ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks efficiently
Professional Engineering License (PE) or equivalent certification
10+ years of professional experience in civil engineering or related field
Experience with structural analysis and design software
Knowledge of sustainable and innovative engineering practices
Experience in site supervision and construction inspection
Strong desire to learn, grow professionally, and advance your career path
Experience working on infrastructure or construction projects in the Middle East region
